716660101.text: Huh? Look, over there by the hot pot stand... We know them!

716660104.text: Yanfei, Shinobu! Here for some hot pot, huh? What's the occasion?

716660107.text: No, it's nothing like that! Wanmin Restaurant's just closed for a couple of days.

716660108.text: But it's nice to try somewhere different for a change. Su Er'niang's hot pot is pretty good, and you can't get it at Wanmin Restaurant.

716660110.text: Well, it was partly our fault...

716660111.text: Recently, some old classmates from the Tongwen Academy got in touch and said they were organizing a get-together.

716660112.text: Yanfei's the most senior among us, since she's the most qualified, so she got to pick the location, and she booked Wanmin Restaurant.

716660113.text: The turnout was a lot higher than expected, and in the space of two days, we somehow got through all of the restaurant's stock for the week ahead. Boss's enormous appetite was also a significant contributing factor... he went a little crazy.

716660114.text: Chef Mao was pretty wiped out by the end, but he had a huge smile on his face. It was the best business he's had in months.

716660115.text: The only thing is, it'll take him a least a couple days to fully restock.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Guyun Stone Forest to look for Xiangling and the others

716660202.text: A hard shell, a whole bunch of legs, looks like a born warrior — the Crab is the Onikabuto of the sea! Throw one of these bad boys in the ring, and your Onikabuto will have to seriously up its game!

716660203.text: That's right, Oni King! Technically, the crab belongs to a different species, but it has all the qualities of the perfect warrior-beetle! Pitting Onikabuto against Crabs during their training is a sure-fire way to rapidly improve their strength!

716660204.text: Then it's time for Crimson Staff and Ironclad Beetle King to train harder than ever before! No rest until they've flipped every Crab in the area onto its back!

716660205.text: And once they're done, we'll just need to stoop down and scoop 'em up! No more chasing Crabs all over the beach!

716660207.text: Looks like Xiangling and Guoba are part of the gang now...

716660210.text: #Huh? {NICKNAME}, Paimon! Fancy meeting you here! Are you guys out for a walk or something?

716660212.text: Well, we were going to gorge ourselves at Wanmin Restaurant, but then we ran into Yanfei and Shinobu, who told us you were closed for a few days... So, we figured we'd come find you guys, and see if you needed any help.

716660213.text: Aw, you guys! Hee-hee, thanks for being such loyal customers. It's so kind of you to help!

716660214.text: With Mr. Itto and the grandmaster helping me for the last couple of days, we've actually got most of the things we need now. All that's left for us to get are some fresh Crabs.

716660215.text: And Crimson Staff and Ironclad Beetle King will be able to round them up for us in no time! If everything goes to plan...

716660216.text: ...Uh-oh, I may have spoken too soon...

716660217.text: It's a Geovishap Hatchling! Bull-Chucker, Hanakado, watch out!

716660218.text: Hold on! Stay calm, I'll assess the situation!

716660219.text: ...Hard shell, check! Legs — not too many, but it more than makes up for that with the whole rolling thing. Yeah, looks like a mean fighter! THIS is what you wanna train your Onikabuto against!

716660220.text: Uhh... Ahem, h—how right you are, Oni King! With a training partner like this, an Onikabuto is sure to reach the apex of its abilities!

716660221.text: Wh—What? Are they serious right now?

716660222.text: Wait, I think I recognize that thing!

716660223.text: It's always rolling around on a nearby island. It's made quite a reputation for itself as far as Guyun Geovishaps go — people have taken to calling it "Crystal Tornado"!

716660302.text: #Guoba, Xiangling, {NICKNAME}, and Paimon... Wait, where are the other two?

716660303.text: Lemme guess... Itto and Hanakado are up to their usual antics?

716660304.text: We'll fill you in shortly! First, I need to get all these pristine ingredients safely stored away — the Mist Flower Corollas won't keep the Crabs cool for much longer!

716660305.text: #Plus, {NICKNAME} and Paimon are valued customers eagerly awaiting a grand feast! I'll get cooking, then we can catch up while we eat...

716660306.text: Xiangling and Guoba whip up a meal from ingredients collected on their trip. It's not long before an exceptional meal is served.

716660307.text: By now, Yanfei and Shinobu are hungry too. The feasting begins.

716660308.text: As you dine, you tell Shinobu and Yanfei about Itto and Hanakado's run-in with Crystal Tornado, and the plan to hold a beetle-fighting boot camp...

716660309.text: "Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp"? That doesn't bode well. It won't be long before things get out of hand...

716660310.text: We're guests here, which means we're supposed to be on our best behavior... Leave them to me, I'll put a stop to it.

716660311.text: Mmm, I dunno, I think it could be fun... Anyway, don't stress! Beetle-fighting sounds like a great event idea!

716660312.text: According to The Comprehensive Compendium of Liyue Law, we just need to notify the relevant office of the Ministry of Civil Affairs, and they'll issue a permit pretty much right away.

716660313.text: You never know, maybe you'll make some new friends with this event! Then you'll have even more people to hang out with when you next come to Liyue!

716660314.text: Yeah! And you can bring them all to Wanmin Restaurant for your meals!

716660316.text: Wait... First the event, and now you're already planning our next trip?

716660317.text: Given the Arataki Gang's financial situation—

716660318.text: Ah, c'mon, you gotta learn to cut loose more! You came all this way — you should be focused on catching up with old friends, making some new ones, and just generally hanging out and doing lots of fun stuff!

716660319.text: I need to be at the Ministry of Civil Affairs shortly for something else anyway, so I can get the ball rolling for Itto's thing while I'm there.

716660320.text: Alright — I'll handle that while you guys head back to Itto and help get the venue set up. I'll join you later and bring the permit with me.

716660321.text: Yanfei's in a good mood today... She didn't take any persuading to help out with the event.

716660322.text: Well, event-planning's right up her alley. She was an officiator in the Masterful Chefs contest, and she has a lot of contacts because of her work.

716660323.text: She's also on vacation at the moment, and her old friend Shinobu's in town. That's definitely put her in the mood to have some fun.

716660324.text: Well, I've missed my chance to discuss the issue of our funds. Guess I've got no choice but to deal with Boss directly now.

716660325.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, thanks for all your help so far. I promise I'll make it up to you the next time we meet!

716660326.text: Huh? You mean, you don't need us to come with you?

716660327.text: But if Itto's serious about defeating that Geovishap Hatchling with Onikabuto, Paimon's kinda curious to see how everything goes down...

716660330.text: Now that you mention it... Didn't you help Boss out a lot at the last one of these? The Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl?

716660331.text: Eh, we didn't really help out, we just played a few matches... But it was actually super fun.

716660332.text: Either way, it sounds like you understand Boss's perspective far better than I do, so maybe you'll be able to help me talk some sense into him. I'll take all the help I can get.

716660333.text: Sure. Or, uh, y'know... Maybe we could just let him go ahead with it... huh?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Guyun Stone Forest again

716660401.text: Alright, Boss. Funtime in Liyue is over. Let's head home.

716660403.text: No, you can't. Our funds have run out.

716660404.text: We've spent too long here. After buying our tickets for the boat home, the gang fund is down to double-digits. How can we possibly afford to hold a tournament?

716660405.text: Yanfei senpai very kindly offered to handle the legalities, otherwise you wouldn't even have a permit. Are you expecting her to foot the bill as well? Put a stop to this now, before things get out of control.

716660406.text: But, but...! You don't understand, we have a situation here! Normally, I'm happy to do things your way, but the Arataki Gang's two top Onikabuto warriors just lost to some pet rock called Crystal Tornado!

716660407.text: Look, we have a whole arena set up and everything! If we back out now, we'll be the laughing stock of the entire beetle-fighting world!

716660408.text: You've lost plenty of beetle fights before. Even I can beat you, and I'm not even a serious player. Why are you so bothered about losing to some vishap hatchling?

716660409.text: Shinobu! That was a low blow!

716660410.text: Anyway, that's ancient history! I'm on a whole different level now. There isn't a single beetle fighter out there who can touch me! I'm serious about beating that pet rock. Don't think I've got what it takes? Try me!

716660411.text: Gladly. You wanna do this the hard way? We'll do it the hard way.

716660412.text: Grandmaster Hanakado, get me and Boss a beetle each. Maybe he'll be more amenable to reason after a crushing defeat.

716660413.text: If I win, you have to come back with me — no complaining, and no making any more trouble for Yanfei senpai.

716660415.text: You're really doing this, huh? I, uh... didn't think you'd take it this far!

716660416.text: Okay, uh... so... Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon! I delegate this challenge to you!

716660421.text: What Bull-Chu{RUBY#[S]"Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King"}cker is really saying is... "If you wanna fight the Oni King, you have to go through Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon first!"

716660422.text: Exactamundo, amigo. Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon is one of the Arataki Gang's top beetle fighters, but even she isn't in the same league as moi. So Shinobu, if you wanna duel with the don, you gotta beat the melon!

716660425.text: Even Paimon knows that you can't just expect other people to pick up your slack all the time. It's not right! So if you're out of Mora, then tough luck — you gotta watch your spending.

716660426.text: If Paimon helps you out, that'll just make more trouble for Yanfei, and then Shinobu will owe her a favor.

716660427.text: Okay, true... You make a fair point.

716660428.text: But it's all good! I have a backup plan for situations like this!

716660429.text: If we really are out of funds, then... I'll find a job. I'll work nights, do beetle fighting during the day, and pay any expenses out of my own pocket!

716660430.text: It'll work. The Grandmaster has helped me find a few good gigs before. As long as it's physical work and the pay's good, I'll take it!

716660431.text: Now you're talking! See, that's the kind of attitude Paimon can get behind.

subQuests.subQuestName: Engage in a beetle battle with Kuki Shinobu
Return to the beetle battle arena

716660501.text: After a fierce battle, Shinobu's Onikabuto narrowly loses to Crimson Staff under Paimon's direction...

716660502.text: I lost... I can't believe it...

716660503.text: That... that was so tense! Shinobu nearly got the better of Paimon there...

716660506.text: Hey hey! Hahaha, hey hey! Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon destroys Shinobu on the first attempt, haha! ...You really are a natural at this, aren't you?

716660507.text: As agreed, we now have Shinobu's official support to host the Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp!

716660508.text: I haven't battled in ages. Guess I'm out of practice...

716660509.text: I'll have to move to plan B: Try to keep costs to a minimum, and make sure Yanfei senpai doesn't end up doing everything for us...

716660510.text: I'm gonna hold you to your word, Boss! Fund this event yourself by working nights, battle beetles all you want during the day.

716660511.text: And one other thing... Our boat tickets home were booked well in advance. I can amend the date, but only by a few days. So keep this event to maybe four or five other people tops, or you'll run out of time, okay? I don't want you getting carried away.

716660512.text: Got it! Sure! Promise! Cross my heart and hope to die! Shinobu, you've got nothing to worry about!

716660513.text: Okay, I'll head down to the harbor and see about changing the tickets... I'm warning you, you'd better not go spending all our Mora while I'm gone!

716660514.text: Okay... So we've only got five battles to get in shape enough for Guoba-san. Then we gotta master what he teaches us, THEN take down that cocky pe{RUBY#[S]"Crystal Tornado"}t rock...

716660515.text: Shinobu is asking us to do the impossible here!

716660516.text: But this is the kind of hardcore challenge I live for! Hahahaha!

716660517.text: Don't worry, Oni King. I'll find people to join us in our great training endeavor. So long as there are worthy beetle-battlers to be found, I'll be sure to sense their presence, and bring them over to our camp.

716660518.text: We haven't been in Liyue for long, but I'm certain that this vast land is filled with mighty warriors... We'll have no trouble finding but one of these each day.

716660519.text: Now, as for the esteemed Oni King's Right Hand and honorable Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon—

716660520.text: Ohoho, we've done our part! We saved your butts by getting Shinobu to agree to this! Paimon saw the look of sheer terror on your faces, you're clearly no match for her!

716660701.text: "Due to a shortage of ingredients, Wanmin Restaurant will be closed for a week..."

716660702.text: "We'd like to thank all our customers for your understanding and support. We will reopen as soon as we can, and continue providing the most delectable of dishes for everyone!"

716661001.text: Ugh... I'm suddenly feeling a bit warm. Maybe I've been eating too much spicy food lately...?

716661002.text: Oh no, you poor thing! It could be a fever, or maybe the humidity's making you overheat? Wait here, I'll go get you some iced tea!

716661101.text: We've already beaten our expected turnover for this month, and it'll still be a while before dad gets back with the rest of the new stock. So, we should be able to take it easy for a while.

716661102.text: After that, we should be back to business as usual — things won't be anywhere near as busy as they've been the last few days. That means, we should have time to go and watch Mr. Itto's beetle-fighting event!

716669901.text: ...Hey, you know where we haven't been in the longest time? Wanmin Restaurant.

716669902.text: #Paimon suddenly has a craving for food that makes you feel like your mouth's on fire! {NICKNAME}, can we go to Wanmin Restaurant, pleeease?
